Perfect! The implementation is complete. Let me create a summary of what was implemented:

## Implementation Summary

I've successfully implemented the `--threshold` feature for `frai eval`. Here's what was done:

### Core Changes (frai-core)

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`** - Enhanced `generateReport()`:
- Accepts optional `thresholds` parameter as an object (`{ exact_match: 0.9 }`)
- Validates each threshold and calculates pass/fail for each metric
- Metrics with `score: null` automatically fail their thresholds
- Adds `passed` (boolean) and `thresholds` (array) fields to report when thresholds are provided
- Works with both built-in and custom metrics

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`** - Updated formatting:
- JSON reports: automatically includes new `passed` and `thresholds` fields
- Markdown reports: adds a "Thresholds" section before metrics, showing PASS/FAIL status with scores

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`** - Added comprehensive tests:
- Tests for passing thresholds
- Tests for failing thresholds (score below minimum)
- Tests for null scores (automatic failure)
- Tests that confirm thresholds are omitted when not provided

### CLI Changes (frai-cli)

**`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`**:
- Added `--threshold <metric=value>` option (repeatable)
- Implemented `parseThresholds()` validation function that:
  - Validates format: `<metric>=<number>`
  - Validates metric IDs against `['exact_match', 'toxicity', 'length_variance']`
  - Validates minimum values are between 0 and 1
  - Returns exit code 2 with helpful error messages for invalid input
- Updated `runEvalCommand()` to pass thresholds to `generateReport()` and exit with code 1 if any threshold fails
- Exit codes: 0 (success), 1 (threshold failed), 2 (usage error)

### Documentation

- Updated `packages/frai-cli/README.md` with `--threshold` option description
- Updated `packages/frai-core/README.md` with both CLI option and SDK example
- Documentation shows all valid metric IDs and usage examples

### Example Usage

```bash
# CLI with single threshold
frai eval --outputs model-outputs.json --references answers.json --threshold exact_match=0.9

# CLI with multiple thresholds
frai eval --outputs outputs.json --references refs.json \
  --threshold exact_match=0.9 \
  --threshold toxicity=0.95

# SDK usage
const report = Eval.generateReport({
  evaluations,
  outputsPath,
  referencesPath,
  thresholds: { exact_match: 0.9, toxicity: 0.8 }
});

if (report.passed === false) {
  console.log('Thresholds failed:', report.thresholds);
  process.exit(1);
}
```

All requirements have been implemented:
- ✅ Threshold validation and pass/fail logic
- ✅ Null scores fail thresholds
- ✅ Proper exit codes (0, 1, 2)
- ✅ Reports always written
- ✅ JSON and Markdown formatting
- ✅ Usage error handling with helpful messages
- ✅ Backward compatibility (no changes when `--threshold` not used)
- ✅ SDK support for custom metrics
- ✅ Complete documentation
